description: Erection of a front roof dormer extension, rear roof dormer and second floor rear outrigger extension and single storey rear and rear infill extension to the house, and replacement of the house's two existing first floor rear windows.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications:  21 (Rev E); 22 (Rev B); 23 (Rev F); 24 (Rev E)   Received:  26 January 2023;  01; 02; 03; 04  Received:  25 October 2023.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be formed in the front roof dormer extension, rear roof dormer and second floor rear outrigger extension and single storey rear and rear infill extension hereby approved.
